description: Source code for the ProcessHost class managing child processes, IPC communication, and process lifecycle in the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: ProcessHost
classes.description: Manages a child process, handles IPC messaging, process lifecycle events, and environment variables.

methods.name: startRunner
methods.description: Starts the child process with specified runner parameters and options, sets up event handlers.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the child process and returns a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message without expecting a reply.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Hook for handling process exit, can be overridden.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Registers a handler for incoming IPC requests.

methods.name: didSendStop
methods.description: Returns whether a stop signal has been sent to the process.

methods.name: producedEnv
methods.description: Returns environment variables produced by the child process.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Internal method to send a message to the child process.
